Style: cinematic-realistic with moody lighting and dramatic reflections. A quiet apartment at night with rain falling outside the window. A woman in her mid-20s with long dark hair sits by the window wearing a soft sweater, holding a warm mug with both hands. The camera starts with a close-up of raindrops sliding down the glass while distant thunder rumbles. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal her reflection in the window. She looks outside thoughtfully before turning slightly toward the camera. In a soft reflective voice she says:
"Some nights the rain makes everything feel a little quieter."
The camera gently pans toward the rain again while city lights blur in the background. Sounds include steady rainfall, distant traffic, and a faint rumble of thunder.
